summary: The GEO and registered results agree in direction for 10,722 of 11,173 paired genes (95.96%), passing the author-concordance-v2 direction criterion. At the paper’s adjusted P < 0.1 cutoff, six genes are shared between 43 author calls and seven registered calls. The Figure 2C caption reports Npy’s raw P of 1.75e-7 as adjusted. The deposit gives adjusted P = 0.00046317, consistent with the first author’s thesis. The comparison replayed byte-for-byte. [Manuscript](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC6667392/) · [Thesis, Table 8.4](https://research.manchester.ac.uk/files/83388204/FULL_TEXT.PDF#page=227)
openIssues: Exact historical reproduction requires the authors’ DESeq2 version and original commands specifying the coefficient prior, independent filtering and Cook’s handling. The earlier refit remains a conditional diagnostic. No contrast is proposed for full verification.
The thesis PDF download returned HTTP 403. The evidence folder retains the publicly indexed methods and appendix rows. The GEO statistics independently reproduce Npy’s adjusted P.
Adopting the proposal requires updating the active source-bound effects review because it pins the wording of the previous assessment. No ledger was edited.
